title: Darkwhisper Gorge
wikitext:
'''Darkwhisper Gorge''' {{co|60|75|Winterspring}} is an area in the far south of [[Winterspring]] which consists of a network of tunnels and chasms. This area is inhabited by [[elite]] [[demons]] of an approximate five-man difficulty, although easily solable by a level 70.[[Image:Darkwhisper Gorge.jpg|thumb|Darkwhisper Gorge]]

This treacherous cavern lies along Winterspring Valley's southern slope. Poisonous green vapours bubble out of acid pools deep within the bottom of the gorge. Malevolent sounds echo from a cave at the furthest end of the gorge, leading some night elves to believe that demons may have taken refuge in the toxic depths.

The demons in this area are important to a number of quests, unlike their [[Blasted Lands]] counterparts. The terrain is considerably grim and foreboding - the presence of poisonous green vapors bubbling from acid pools in the bottom of the gorge is warning enough to many travellers to keep out. Despite the hazards, this area possess several valuable resources, including [[rich thorium vein]]s.

Notably, the Hederine demons which inhabit this area drop {{loot|Common|Tears of the Hederine}}, a quest item for the [[warlock]] quest {{quest|The Prison's Casing}}, the second quest in the chain which leads to the acquisition of the [[Doomguard (warlock minion)|doomguard]].

Also, the [[Hederine Slayers]] and the [[Hederine Initiate]]s have a very small chance (0.5%) to drop {{loot|Epic|The Eye of Shadow}}, a quest item in the epic [[priest]] quest to obtain {{loot|Epic|Benediction (staff)|Benediction}}.

An [[imp]], [[Vi'el]], lives in a cave in the Gorge. Among other “exotic reagents", he sells several items of particular note:
*{{loot|Common|Gromsblood}} (3-5) {{cost|s=10}}
*{{loot|Common|Felcloth}} (1) {{cost|s=80}}
*{{loot|Common|Fel Elemental Rod}} {{cost|g=40}} (Required for the [[Dungeon Set 2]] upgrade quest)

"Unused Instance Portal" - An instance portal with a runed gate exists in the lower part of the Gorge. It can be found [[Image:Darkwhispergorgeportal.jpg|thumb|A screen shot of the unused instance portal. If one looks closely, they can see trees.]] at {{co|50|83|Winterspring}}. This is most likely the entrance to [[Hyjal]], as one can see trees and grass behind the portal.
